digest.component_or_area: plan-review-T10 overlay rubric and eval spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable infrastructure evaluation from transient de-risk experiments while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes
Scope clause must explicitly exclude transient throwaway experiments and their creation/isolation/teardown from routine durable-infra checks

Four-MAJOR-class co-located safety qualifier must immediately follow the scope clause to preserve destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-network-endpoint protections for transient infrastructure

Packaged eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls (scoped teardown probe, fully specified durable infra, private-network scoped-IAM probe, secret-manager retrieval, sandbox teardown isolation) and five finding controls (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, untrusted-network transient service)
T10 rubric must remain independent and not reference T15 or delegate scope to other overlays

Offline text-contract tests must lock exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier adjacency, and rubric independence; live criterion eval must prove agentic discrimination across all ten balanced cases with stable recall and zero false accepts
